text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Nishino Flower!
That was incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
I...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
!
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
This person right here is my Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You're a truly wonderful Trainer
who has run alongside me all the way here...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh~!
Way to go, ace Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm sorry!
But I've wanted to do this for so long.
I wanted you to know!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That my Trainer is...
the absolute best Trainer ever!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Did I... blossom beautifully?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I was out-bloomed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, congratulations!
That was an exemplary... no, an ideal display of speed!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't... repay my debt to you, could I?
And yet, seeing you run—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I can simply chase the wind I've always admired.
...No, I can overtake it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Good luck,
Zephyr-san!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. You too...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Mm. Just now... I caught a scent on the wind.
Could this be... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The future will surely... come.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me,
Nishino Flower, and Trainer!
Could you share your joy of victory with us?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll take my leave...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes♪
Afterward, following an interview in the Winner's Circle...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thank you for your hard work!
choice_data_list: Good work out there too, Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Standing up so tall and straight while talking,
you looked super cool, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I bet I worked this hard all this way
just so I could see that sight...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's not true!
It's because you worked so hard, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Um.
Why don't we just say it's thanks to both of them?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep building so many wonderful things
together in the future ahead!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe.
Um, hey, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Because you raised me with such care, I was able to bloom this beautifully.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for always supporting me.
Thank you for giving me... the courage to keep going!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Thank you so much for meeting me♪
